trans-unit.source: Admin allowed IP addresses:Administrators only can log in from one of the followin IP addresses. You can set multiple addresses like '127.0.0.1, 192.168.0.1'. Set to '*' or leave empty to allow all addresses.

Regular users allowed IP addresses:Regular, non-admin users only can log in from one of the followin IP addresses. You can set multiple addresses like '127.0.0.1, 192.168.0.1'. Set to '*' or leave empty to allow all addresses.
